![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

To ensure that parsed input shape failures or malformed entries flow into validation and cause the validator to fail closed, we should add an explicit validator check that asserts no input diagnostics or shape failures were recorded.

```javascript
  const checks = [
    check('critical_input_files_loaded', criticalDiagnostics.length === 0, {
      critical_diagnostic_count: criticalDiagnostics.length,
      sample_diagnostics: criticalDiagnostics.slice(0, 10),
    }),
    check('no_input_diagnostics_recorded', !diagnostics.some((d) => d.code === 'malformed_entry' || d.code === 'input_shape_failure'), {
      diagnostic_count: diagnostics.filter((d) => d.code === 'malformed_entry' || d.code === 'input_shape_failure').length,
    }),
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure that parsed input shape failures, missing files, or malformed entries flow into validation by adding a validator check (such as verifying that no input diagnostics were recorded) so that the validator fails closed.
</details>
